title: Africa's 6-year lag in new instrument models is about what its 69 datasets predict
sub:
First release year of 15 instrument models (≥100 datasets; first ≥5 in 2014 or later) in deposits from each continent
(PI country; 28,225 of 36,249 datasets), in years after its first appearance anywhere; lag = median over models seen.
Ring: median first year expected if labels were independent of continent within each year (volume-matched null). A deposit is not a purchase record.
notes: † Hypergeometric null treating datasets as independent; it ignores contributor clustering, so p-values are too small (≈4.5 of 90 pairs expected below .05 by chance).
